author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000086845

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
CG14411 (FBgn0030582, Q9VY15) 

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation

CG14411 (FBgn0030582, Q9VY15) is getting "phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate phosphatase activity" via PTN000086845 but the gene is also annotated with a manual "NOT phosphatase activity".
So I think we need to block this IBA annotation to CG14411.
title: PTN000086845

author: marcfeuermann
body: I've blocked the annotation for the part of the family that includes MTMR10, MTMR11 and MTMR12 nodes. These all seem not to have the phosphatase activity. Thank you for pointing out this error.
